inputs.source: USGS 50092000 RIO GRANDE DE PATILLAS NR PATILLAS, PR
blockers: USGS instantaneous values are provisional until revised/approved
topology must prove whether this station captures the complete external inflow required by the reservoir boundary
ungauged tributary or local runoff contributions must be explicitly included or excluded

inputs.source: USGS 50093045 LAGO PATILLAS AT DAMSITE NEAR PATILLAS, PR
blockers: current instantaneous values are provisional subject to revision
measurement uncertainty/calibration state must be bound to each admitted observation

inputs.source: USGS 50093053 CANAL DE PATILLAS AT FOREBAY plus USGS 50093045 temporary gate-opening heights
inputs.parameter: 00060 discharge; gate opening heights are operational-only
blockers: forebay discharge is downstream of the release point and may embed intervening gains/losses
gate opening height is not discharge without an authoritative rating/operation relation
USGS states gate-opening data are temporary operational data not suitable for archival scientific interpretation
inputs.next_public_path: search authoritative PREPA/AEE canal rating, gate-operation, or archived release tables before any operator request

inputs.source: Puerto Rico Statistics / AAA Untreated Water Extractions and Production
inputs.parameter: average monthly raw-water extraction/production in MGD by plant
blockers: annual publication with average monthly values is too coarse for a synchronized 15-minute balance slice
USGS 50093075 minus 50093078 can be a derived diversion estimate only when synchronized and cannot be labeled a direct plant meter

inputs.source: USGS 50093078 below Guayama Filtration Plant and USGS 50093083 above AES intake
blockers: neither station is proven to be the terminal Patillas Canal boundary
downstream diversions between gauges and terminal boundary must be enumerated
instantaneous records are provisional until revision

inputs.source: NOAA/NWS MRMS Caribbean precipitation products plus USGS 50093045 point precipitation
inputs.parameter: gridded precipitation rate/QPE; USGS parameter 00045 as local cross-check
blockers: must freeze the exact reservoir-water-surface geometry appropriate to each stage or a validated stage-area relation
MRMS cells must be clipped and area-weighted for the exact balance interval
radar/QPE uncertainty must be quantified and point gauge retained as an independent cross-check

inputs.source: USGS regional/historical evaporation estimates and meteorological precursors
blockers: historical pan evaporation is not a synchronized current open-water evaporation measurement
an interval model would require meteorological inputs, conversion/model version, water-surface area, and uncertainty
no public current direct interval Lago Patillas evaporation stream was found in the v0.5 sweep

inputs.source: PREPA/AEE public transition records describe Canal de Patillas operations and consumers but no interval loss ledger was found
blockers: public records reviewed do not provide synchronized reservoir flushing, leakage, spill, canal maintenance discharge, or other operational-loss volumes
unmeasured conveyance loss must not be inserted as a balancing term

public_context_findings: DRNA describes Canal de Patillas as originating at Embalse Patillas, operated by AEE/PREPA, serving irrigation and public supply including the Guayama filtration plant.
AEE 2024 transition material states the Patillas irrigation system serves two AAA filtration plants, agriculture, AES, domestic services, and other contracted uses.
AAA public statistics provide monthly-average raw-water extraction and plant production, not synchronized interval plant-meter data.
USGS reservoir gate-opening heights are explicitly temporary operational data and are not an archival discharge series.
